column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each regulatory/maintenance record.
A VARCHAR(20) showing the maintenance status (e.g., ‘Overdue’, ‘Up to Date’, ‘Due’).
A DATE indicating the date of the most recent maintenance operation.
A DATE specifying the scheduled or expected date for the next maintenance.
A VARCHAR(20) describing calibration status (e.g., ‘Expired’, ‘Valid’, ‘Due’).
A DATE for the most recent calibration event.
A DATE for the next scheduled calibration.
A VARCHAR(20) indicating documentation completeness (e.g., 'Missing', 'Complete', 'Partial').
A REAL number reflecting a compliance or condition score assigned to the shipment/vehicle.
A VARCHAR(50) denoting risk level or category (e.g., ‘High Risk’, ‘Low Risk’, ‘Medium Risk’).
A SMALLINT counting the number of recorded incidents or violations.
A VARCHAR(50) specifying how or if those incidents were resolved.
A VARCHAR(100) naming the responsible person or officer in charge.
A VARCHAR(50) for the primary contact phone/ID.
A VARCHAR(50) for emergency contact phone/ID details.
A DATE showing when the last official inspection was completed.
A DATE specifying when the next inspection is scheduled or due.
A VARCHAR(50) describing the overall outcome or result of the last inspection.
A TEXT field detailing corrective actions taken post-inspection or post-incident.
A TEXT field describing preventive measures planned or implemented.
A VARCHAR(20) indicating the current validity status (e.g., 'In Process', 'Validated', 'Failed').
A VARCHAR(50) naming the verification method or standard used.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Shipments(ShipmentRegistry), linking this record to a shipment.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing TransportInfo(VehicleReg), linking this record to a vehicle.
